subject: I need to tell you something
body:
You went to Cavaryn. On purpose. Through a termite.

I haven't been honest with you. I'm not busy, and the door isn't stuck. I'm scared of ants. Properly scared. Elythia is beautiful, but it's full of them. I haven't set foot outside the lab since I got here. Grim goes out for me.

So that's why it's been you out there instead of me. Sorry! :)

Your old friend,
Dr. T
